title: 10 tips for effective flyer design - DoxZoo

facts.fact: The DoxZoo blog article '10 tips for effective flyer design' was published on 17 October 2022.
DoxZoo's blog post offers a promotion: register and save 10% on your first 2 orders.
facts.quote: REGISTER AND SAVE 10% ON YOUR FIRST 2 ORDERS

facts.fact: The DoxZoo article '10 tips for effective flyer design' by George McCann was first published on 17 October 2022.
According to DoxZoo, professional stock images on platforms such as Shutterstock and Adobe Stock can be bought for under £10.
facts.quote: you can buy professional images for under £10

facts.fact: DoxZoo states that A5 is a very popular flyer format because it is large enough to hold all the information and is less likely to get lost in the post.
facts.quote: A5 is a very popular format

facts.fact: DoxZoo defines the AIDA formula as Attention, Interest, Desire, and Action.
facts.quote: AIDA stands for Attention, Interest, Desire, and Action.

facts.fact: The Facebook cookie _fbp, per the page's cookie table, has a duration of 3 months and is set by Facebook to store and track interactions.
facts.quote: Facebook sets this cookie to store and track interactions.

facts.fact: The Bing cookie MUID, per the page's cookie table, has a duration of 1 year 24 days and is used for advertising, site analytics, and other operations.
facts.quote: Bing sets this cookie to recognise unique web browsers visiting Microsoft sites.

facts.fact: QR stands for Quick Response, and scanning a QR code with a smartphone or tablet can open websites, documents, or videos.
facts.quote: QR stands for Quick Response. Indeed you had seen a QR code before and maybe scanned it. This allows you to access websites, documents, videos etc., by scanning them with your smartphone or tablet.

facts.fact: The article recommends using a QR code to link directly to a website landing page, such as one with an enquiry or order form, so the person can act on a smartphone or tablet.
facts.quote: you can use the QR code to link directly to a page on your website (landing page), on which there is, for example, an enquiry or order form

facts.fact: The article lists phone, email, fax, and website as contact information channels that can be included on a flyer.
facts.quote: Contact information can include phone, email, fax and/or website.

facts.fact: The Doxzoo site footer shows a copyright notice of 2024 for Doxzoo Ltd.
facts.quote: Copyright © 2024 Doxzoo Ltd. All Rights Reserved.
